reference.description: re-computes the AR spectrum with stats::spec.ar (bit-exact) on the identical signal; reports the AR alpha peak (Hz), the bit-exact spec.ar agreement, the frequency-bin count, whether the peak is in the alpha band, the nonparametric periodogram peak, and the cross-method peak difference
